cli.description: Declarative development environment installer and shell manager.

option.addLog: Write logs to an additional file (repeatable).

option.emailDomain: Default email domain for user setup.

install.description: Install packages and their dependencies (defaults to current .levain.yaml).

update.force: Force update even when already up to date.

shell.description: Open a configured Levain shell for packages (defaults to current .levain.yaml).

activate.description: Activate a Levain environment in the current shell.

clean.description: Clean backups, temporary files, logs, or cache.

uninstall.rawConflict: Cannot combine --raw and --uninstall. Use --uninstall to generate a manual cleanup guide.
uninstall.noInstalled: No installed packages found in Levain's registry. Pass package names explicitly (e.g. "levain explain --uninstall maven" or "levain explain --uninstall levain").
uninstall.titleAll: Manual uninstall & cleanup guide (all installed packages)
uninstall.title: Manual uninstall guide: {{packages}}
uninstall.subtitle: Follow these steps in order to manually remove the selected packages, environment entries, shortcuts, and registry keys. Review commands before running them.
uninstall.windowsShellNote: **Note:** Run the commands below in **Windows PowerShell** (not CMD or Git Bash), unless stated otherwise.
uninstall.dependentWarning: **Warning:** Installed package(s) {{dependents}} depend on `{{pkg}}`. Removing `{{pkg}}` may break them.
uninstall.levainFullRemovalWarning: **Warning:** Other packages are still installed ({{packages}}). Removing Levain's root directory will delete their install folders without cleaning up their environment variables, `PATH`, shortcuts, or Registry entries. Run `levain explain --uninstall` (without arguments) for a complete cleanup guide.
uninstall.noSteps: No persistent files, environment variables, or registry entries to remove for this package.
uninstall.stepActivateCmd: Remove CMD activation hook file `{{hookPath}}` (`{{removeHookCmd}}`), then inspect `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Command Processor\AutoRun` via `reg query "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Command Processor" /v AutoRun`. If the `@IF EXIST "{{hookPath}}" CALL "{{hookPath}}"` hook is the only value, delete it with `reg delete "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Command Processor" /v AutoRun /f` (otherwise remove only the Levain segment in `regedit`).
uninstall.stepActivatePowershell: Open your PowerShell profile (`notepad $PROFILE.CurrentUserCurrentHost`, if it exists) and remove the block between `# >>> levain initialize >>>` and `# <<< levain initialize <<<`.
uninstall.stepActivatePowershellCustom: In PowerShell profile `{{profile}}`, remove the block between `# >>> levain initialize >>>` and `# <<< levain initialize <<<`.
uninstall.stepActivateBash: In your Bash profile ({{profiles}}, whichever exists), remove the block between `# >>> levain initialize >>>` and `# <<< levain initialize <<<`.
uninstall.stepActivateCmder: In Cmder config directory `{{configDir}}`, delete `levain_prompt.lua` and remove the block between `# >>> levain initialize >>>` and `# <<< levain initialize <<<` from `user_profile.ps1`.
uninstall.stepContextMenu:
Remove Windows Explorer context menu item {{label}}:
   - `{{cmd1}}`
   - `{{cmd2}}`
uninstall.stepRemovePermanentPath: Remove `{{dir}}` from your permanent user `PATH` (via Environment Variables UI or PowerShell): `{{cmd}}`
uninstall.stepRemoveRegistryEntry: Remove package from Levain installed registry `{{file}}`: `{{cmd}}`
uninstall.reviewExternalDir: Review directory created outside the package folder at `{{dir}}` — check for files owned by other tools before removing it.
uninstall.reviewExternalClone: Review Git repository cloned outside the package folder at `{{dir}}` — check for uncommitted or unpushed work before removing it.
uninstall.reviewExternalFile: Review and remove files created/copied outside the package folder at `{{target}}`.
uninstall.reviewJsonSet: In JSON file `{{file}}`, review or revert property `{{property}}`.
uninstall.reviewPropertySet: In properties file `{{file}}`, review or revert property `{{property}}`.
uninstall.reviewBackupFile: Check for timestamped backup files (`{{file}}.*.bkp`) and restore or delete them if no longer needed.
uninstall.reviewShellCommand: Review side effects of shell command run during installation: `{{command}}`
uninstall.reviewCmdConfigReg: Optional CMD ergonomics imported from `cmd-config.reg` under `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Command Processor`: `CompletionChar`, `PathCompletionChar`, `EnableExtensions`, `DisableUNCCheck` (revert only if you do not want tab completion / UNC support).
uninstall.reviewWin11ContextMenu: Optional Windows 11 classic context menu override installed with `contextMenu`: to restore the default Windows 11 menu, run `reg delete "HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c95bae2a2}" /f` and restart Windows Explorer.
uninstall.finalRemoveHome: Remove the Levain root directory (includes `.levain` registry, backups, temp files, and `levain` binaries) `{{dir}}`: `{{cmd}}`
uninstall.finalRemoveCache: Remove the Levain download cache directory `{{dir}}`: `{{cmd}}`
uninstall.finalRemoveConfigFile: Remove the Levain user configuration file `{{file}}`: `{{cmd}}`
uninstall.finalRemoveUserInfo: Remove saved Levain user profile/info file (if present) `{{file}}`: `{{cmd}}`
uninstall.finalCleanTemp: Optionally delete temporary Levain logs and upgrade folders (`levain-*.log`, `levain-temp-*`, `levain`) inside your OS temp directory (`%TEMP%` or `/tmp`).
uninstall.finalRestartShells: Close and reopen all open terminals (CMD, PowerShell, Git Bash, Cmder, IDEs) so removed `PATH` and environment variables take effect.
